recentItems.title: TMPD officer Peter 'Gagash' Nonyane and wife Charlotte Tibana bail hearing - 04 September 2026
recentItems.description:
The bail application of Tshwane Metro Police Department, TMPD, officer and his wife, continues in the Polokwane magistrate's court. 

The Tswane Metro Police Department's officer who is also a socialite, Peter "Gagash" Nonyane and his wife who is a lawyer, Charlotte Tibana continue to apply for bail at the Polokwane magistrate court.  They are facing 35 charges of fraud and money laundering.  They allegedly defrauded five families of the funds from estate accounts between 2024 and this year.  They allegedly spent the money on a luxiurous life, including multiple cars, branded clothes and houses.

recentItems.title: Modjadji royal family battle in court - Day 3
recentItems.description:
Its day three in the legal battle for the Balobedu throne at the High Court in Pretoria this morning. The Modjadji Royal family brought the application, seeking to overturn president Cyril Ramaphosa's recognition of Masalanabo Modjadji as Queen of the Balobedu people. 
Some members of the royal family want Queen Masalanabo Modjadji the seventh's brother, Prince Lekukela Modjadji, to be King. One of the submissions made to the court yesterday, was that the Queen did not undergo initiation in accordance with the Balobedu customs. SABC News Reporter Pimani Baloyi is in Pretoria and joins us live.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.
